title: Данные и код к статье «Больше розницы, не меньше эффективности: российский рынок акций после 2022 года»
description:
Replication data and code for the article ‘More Retail, No Less Efficiency: The Russian Stock Market after 2022’ by Marsel Salikhov.

The package contains ticker-day measures for 60 Russian equities in 2021–2025 (5,732 observations), alternative sampling specifications, trading-rule results, figure data, experiment configuration, run manifests, reference estimates, and an independent Python replication script. A synthetic order-book snapshot example demonstrates the calculation of measures. Raw Moscow Exchange order logs and real order-book snapshots are not included.

Run python replicate.py --check to compare independently recomputed estimates with the reference values. Instructions are provided in Russian and English. Data are licensed under CC BY 4.0; the replication code is licensed under MIT, as specified in LICENSE-data and LICENSE.
